Modifications: [describe actual changes].

processing: Preserve original positions, normals, tangents, UVs and triangle indices byte-for-byte.
Preserve existing node transforms and scene orientation/nominal 21 mm presentation scale exactly.
No subdivision, simplification, smoothing, root grafting, added shell geometry or anatomy deformation.
Disable the native COLOR_0 material multiplier to prevent double-darkening; its original bytes remain in the source buffer.
Derive and soften the crown/root mask from original painted colors, then author a calibrated off-white/cream color texture with slow subtle variation and restrained native color relief.
Use IOR 1.62, restrained enamel transmission and an explicitly illustrative single-surface volume thickness; no measured tissue optics are claimed.
limitations: CT-informed educational reconstruction, not an untouched high-resolution microCT scan.
Native roots and occlusal anatomy preserved; clinical accuracy not independently validated.
No segmented enamel shell/dentine core or measured thickness supplied.
Calibrated color and PBR settings are artistic visualization approximations, not photographic or measured surface color.
Single-surface transmission/volume approximates translucency, not full volumetric subsurface scattering.
